sources.sql: SELECT r.id,r.con_xb,r.barcode,r.grade,r.begin_date,r.end_date,r.warranty,r.remark,r.isyb,r.state, CONCAT('fb_service:',r.id,':',COALESCE(r.barcode,'')) AS renewalSourceKey FROM fb_service r WHERE r.barcode IS NOT NULL AND r.barcode<>'' AND (:deviceSns='' OR FIND_IN_SET(r.barcode,:deviceSns)) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM fb_shipment_barcode sb WHERE sb.barcode=r.barcode AND (sb.rma_no IS NULL OR sb.rma_no='' OR sb.rma_no='null') AND sb.pack_id IN (SELECT selectedPackages.packlist_id FROM (SELECT s.packlist_id FROM fb_shipment s STRAIGHT_JOIN fb_contract c ON c.contract_id=s.con_id WHERE c.contract_type IN (0,11) AND c.contract_code IN (SELECT approved.contractNo FROM (SELECT DISTINCT pc.contractNo FROM pm_project_group_relationship m STRAIGHT_JOIN pm_project_group g ON g.projectGroupCode=m.projectGroupCode STRAIGHT_JOIN pm_project p ON p.projectCode=REPLACE(m.projectCode,'-his','') AND p.projectType=g.projectType STRAIGHT_JOIN pm_project_contract pc ON pc.projectGroupCode=g.projectGroupCode WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pm_project newer WHERE newer.projectCode=p.projectCode AND newer.projectId>p.projectId AND CAST(newer.projectCode AS BINARY)=CAST(p.projectCode AS BINARY) AND CAST(newer.projectType AS BINARY)=CAST(p.projectType AS BINARY)) AND p.disabled=0 AND p.effectiveTo IS NULL AND FIND_IN_SET(p.projectType,:projectTypes) AND (:projectTypes='' OR FIND_IN_SET(p.projectType,:projectTypes)) AND (:projectIds='' OR FIND_IN_SET(p.projectId,:projectIds))) approved)) selectedPackages))
